title: Free welfare items as a share of consumption, rural India, by decile, 2023-24
sourceIndicatorId: HCES 2023-24 unit-level microdata: imputed free-welfare value as % of MPCE

metadata.provenance: Computed from HCES 2023-24 unit-level microdata using MoSPI's own imputation-rate book (HCES_2023_24_Imputation_Rate.xlsx); free foodgrain (LEVEL-05 codes 061-075) and free durables (LEVEL-11). Calibration: population-weighted average gap reproduces the published +Rs 125 rural / +Rs 82 urban imputation gap.
metadata.method: For each rural decile, the imputed value of items received free through social-welfare programmes, expressed as a percentage of that decile's without-imputation MPCE.
metadata.caveat: The rupee value of free items is broadly flat across deciles (a near-universal foodgrain entitlement), so the share falls as consumption rises. Computed estimate, not an official MoSPI fractile table.
